WITH total_items AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM Order_Items
),
product_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    CASE 
      WHEN COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 0 
      THEN AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4)))
      ELSE NULL
    END as avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as item_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN ti.total_count > 0 
      THEN COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / ti.total_count
      ELSE 0
    END as share
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  CROSS JOIN total_items ti
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, ti.total_count
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_qty_per_type,
    AVG(item_count) as avg_count_per_type,
    AVG(share) as avg_share_per_type
  FROM product_metrics
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_qty_per_type) as final_avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_count_per_type) as final_avg_count,
  AVG(avg_share_per_type) as final_avg_share
FROM type_averages;
